verdict.rationale: Daytona's first-party Computer Use feature provides programmatic control of desktop environments inside sandboxes, with mouse, keyboard, screenshot, screen recording and display operations for GUI automation. VM sandboxes with dedicated Linux or Windows OS further support running full desktop applications. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of running a headless browser (e.g., Playwright/Chromium) in the sandbox, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the desktop environment works as described.
